subject.title: fix(update): keep self-updates on the running install's global root

question: Should OpenClaw accept this npm self-update target-precedence change after exact-head checks, or hold for broader version-manager live proof first?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but global self-update target selection is an upgrade-sensitive path for existing npm installs.

options.title: Merge after exact-head checks
options.body: Accept the bounded compatibility risk once the current head is checked against the current base and required checks pass.

options.title: Hold for broader live proof
options.body: Pause for additional macOS/version-manager update transcripts before changing npm update target precedence.

recommendation.title: Merge after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded compatibility risk once the current head is checked against the current base and required checks pass.
